## Activity

During October 2025, Hill Counties Health Centre recorded 97 captures. This represents the site’s reported imaging activity for the month. The activity record provides the basis for the image-quality and grading results set out below. All figures relate to work completed at Hill Counties Health Centre during October 2025.

## Image quality

Of the 97 captures, 9 were ungradable. The ungradable rate was 9.3. These images could not be included in the grading outcome. The ungradable count and rate are reported alongside the total capture activity to support review of image quality at Hill Counties Health Centre. The figures identify the proportion of monthly captures that did not produce a gradable image.

## Grading

Grading identified 14 referable results from the month’s activity. The median lag between capture and grading was 1. This provides the reported measure of turnaround for grading during October 2025. Together, the activity, image-quality, and grading figures summarise operations at Hill Counties Health Centre for the month.
